column1: # Statutory Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) and Tax Collected at Source (TCS) schedule under the Indian Income-tax Act
# Source: Income Tax Department of India (incometaxindia.gov.in)

column9: Section 194C: payment for carrying out work; 1% for individual or HUF contractors (single > ₹30,000 or aggregate > ₹1,00,000 in FY)
Section 194C: payment for carrying out work; 2% for company, firm or other business entities (single > ₹30,000 or aggregate > ₹1,00,000)
Section 194J(1)(a): professional services including legal, medical, engineering, accountancy, architectural (annual > ₹30,000)

column3: Fees for Technical Services and Royalty
column9: Section 194J(1)(b): fees for technical services (FTS), call centres, software royalty (annual > ₹30,000)

column3: Purchase of Goods by Enterprise with Turnover Exceeding 10 Crore
column9: Section 194Q: TDS on value of goods purchased exceeding ₹50,000,000 in FY; deducted at 0.1% on excess over threshold

column3: Rent for Plant, Machinery and Equipment
column9: Section 194I: rent for the use of any machinery or plant or equipment (annual > ₹2,40,000)

column3: Rent for Land, Building and Furniture
column9: Section 194I: rent for the use of any land or building or furniture/fittings (annual > ₹2,40,000)
Section 194H: commission or brokerage for procurement or agency services (annual > ₹15,000)

column3: Special Provision for Deduction of Tax at Source for Non-Filers
column9: Section 206AB: higher rate of TDS for specified persons who have not filed income tax returns (higher of 2x rate or 5%, up to 20%)

column3: Tax Collected at Source on Sale of Goods (Turnover Exceeding 10 Crore)
column9: Section 206C(1H): TCS collected by seller on receipt of sale consideration exceeding ₹50,000,000 in FY (0.1% on excess)
